mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, a.module, a.action, a.target_type AS targetType, a.target_id AS targetId, a.detail, a.occurred_at AS occurredAt FROM audit_trail a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_trail ( user_id, module, action, target_type, target_id, detail, occurred_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{module}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{detail}, COALESCE(#{occurredAt}, NOW()) )
